Q: Any point Studio Debugger error: Studio is not able to connect to Debugger server A:

TLDR; an update to the Mulesoft runtime bundled with the IDE was missing the Debugger files.

The mule-debugger-5.1.1-mule-server-plugin folder is in every version of the org.mule.tooling.server.4.9.ee_7.21.0.202502030106\mule\server-plugins folders except that latest version that doesn't work for me.

Copying the mule-debugger-5.1.1-mule-server-plugin directory (from an older runtime version) into the 4.9 server-plugs directory fixes the Debugger.

FYI: In the 4.10 version it's renamed from mule-debugger-5.1.1-mule-server-plugin to mule-debugger-mule-server-plugin

Q: Get GCLID thru Measurement Protocol A:
